list.name: sport_type
list.label: Sport Type
list.query: All : all, Outdoor : cycling_outdoor, Zwift : zwift, E-Bike : ebike, Indoor : cycling_indoor

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Rides" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');
SELECT ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(distance_m), 0) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Distance" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(elevation_m), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "Elevation" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_s), 0) AS "Duration" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');

panels.title: TSS

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(tss), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TSS" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');

panels.description:
Training Stress Score

How much training load this period produced.

Calculated from power (preferred) or heart rate.

• < 150 — Easy week

• 150-300 — Moderate training

• 300-450 — Hard training

• 450+ — Very heavy load, watch recovery

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_power)::numeric, 0) AS "Power" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND avg_power > 0 AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_hr)::numeric, 0) AS "HR" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND avg_hr > 0 AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1) AS "Speed" FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND distance_m > 5000 AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');

panels.title: Avg Decoupling (steady)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(aerobic_decoupling)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Decoupling"
FROM activities
WHERE aerobic_decoupling IS NOT NULL
  AND duration_s > 1800
  AND $__timeFilter(date)
  AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}');

panels.description:
Average aerobic decoupling across rides ≥30 min in the selected period.
Lower = better aerobic fitness.

🟢 < 5% — Good aerobic fitness

🟡 5-10% — Moderate drift

🔴 > 10% — Significant drift

Includes interval rides (noisy per ride, but the period average is still directional).

panels.title: vs Previous Period
panels.description:
Compares the current time range against the equivalent
previous window. E.g., if viewing Last 7 days, compares
against the 7 days before that.

🟢 Positive = improvement (for most metrics)

🔴 Negative = decline (for most metrics)

Inverted on Δ Avg HR and Δ Avg Decoupling, where lower
is better — green still means improvement, but the arrow
direction is reversed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Delta";

SELECT ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT SUM(distance_m)/1000.0 FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(distance_m)/1000.0 FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Delta";

SELECT ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT SUM(elevation_m) FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(elevation_m) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Delta";

SELECT ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT SUM(duration_s) FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(duration_s) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0)) / 60.0::numeric, 0) AS "Delta";

SELECT ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tss) FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tss) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Delta";

panels.title: Δ Avg Power

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_power) AS avg FROM activities
  WHERE avg_power > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(date)
    AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
),
prev AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_power) AS avg FROM activities
  WHERE avg_power > 0
    AND date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
    AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
)
SELECT ROUND((curr.avg - prev.avg)::numeric, 0) AS "Delta"
FROM curr, prev;

panels.description: Small samples (1-2 rides per period) can produce noisy deltas — use the All Time Progression trend panel for the smoothed long-term direction.

targets.rawSql:

prev AS (

panels.title: Δ Avg Decoupling

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr AS (
  SELECT AVG(aerobic_decoupling) AS avg FROM activities
  WHERE aerobic_decoupling IS NOT NULL AND duration_s > 1800
    AND $__timeFilter(date)
    AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
),
prev AS (
  SELECT AVG(aerobic_decoupling) AS avg FROM activities
  WHERE aerobic_decoupling IS NOT NULL AND duration_s > 1800
    AND date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)

    AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')

SELECT ROUND((curr.avg - prev.avg)::numeric, 2) AS "Delta"
FROM curr, prev;

panels.description:
Change in average aerobic decoupling vs the previous period of equal length. Negative (green) = decoupling decreased, aerobic base improving.

Small samples (1-2 rides per period) can produce noisy deltas — use the All Time Progression trend panel for the smoothed long-term direction.

panels.title: Distance & Elevation

targets.rawSql: SELECT gs AS "time", COALESCE(SUM(a.distance_m) / 1000.0, 0) AS "Distance (km)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs  AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

SELECT gs AS "time", COALESCE(SUM(a.elevation_m), 0) AS "Elevation (m)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs  AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

panels.description:
Volume — how far and how much climbing per period.
Rising together = bigger rides.
Distance rising but elevation flat = more flat routes.

panels.title: Duration & TSS

targets.rawSql: SELECT gs AS "time", COALESCE(SUM(a.duration_s / 3600.0), 0) AS "Duration (h)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs  AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

SELECT gs AS "time", COALESCE(SUM(a.tss), 0) AS "TSS" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs AND a.tss IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

panels.description:
Training load — duration provides context for TSS.

High TSS from short rides = intense sessions. High TSS from long rides = endurance work.

panels.title: Avg Power & Avg HR

targets.rawSql: SELECT gs AS "time", ROUND(AVG(a.avg_power)::numeric, 0) AS "Power (W)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs AND a.avg_power > 0 AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

SELECT gs AS "time", ROUND(AVG(a.avg_hr)::numeric, 0) AS "HR (bpm)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs AND a.avg_hr > 0 AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

panels.description:
Efficiency — same power at lower HR over time = fitness improving.

When these lines diverge (power up, HR down), aerobic fitness is building.

panels.title: Avg Speed & Avg Cadence

targets.rawSql: SELECT gs AS "time", ROUND(AVG(a.avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1) AS "Speed (km/h)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs AND a.avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND a.distance_m > 5000 AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

SELECT gs AS "time", ROUND(AVG(a.avg_cadence)::numeric, 0) AS "Cadence (rpm)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs AND a.avg_cadence > 0 AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

panels.description:
Technique — higher cadence at same speed = more efficient pedaling.

Watch for cadence trends after bike fit changes or drill blocks.

panels.title: Calories & Rides

targets.rawSql: SELECT gs AS "time", COALESCE(SUM(a.calories), 0) AS "Calories (kcal)" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs AND a.calories IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

SELECT gs AS "time", COALESCE(COUNT(a.id), 0) AS "Rides" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('${group_by}', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '1 ${group_by}'::interval) gs LEFT JOIN activities a ON date_trunc('${group_by}', a.date) = gs  AND (CASE WHEN '${sport_type}' = 'all' THEN TRUE ELSE a.sport_type = '${sport_type}' END) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs;

panels.description: Activity summary — energy output and riding frequency per period.

panels.title: Rolling Weekly Volume

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  ROUND((weekly_distance_m / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Weekly Distance (km)",
  ROUND(weekly_elevation_m::numeric, 0) AS "Weekly Elevation (m)"
FROM athlete_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
ORDER BY date;

panels.description:
7-day rolling distance and elevation from daily fitness calculations.

Smoother than per-ride charts — shows your training volume trend.

Note: always shows **all sports** combined. `athlete_stats` is sport-agnostic by design (training load / CTL are whole-athlete metrics), so this panel ignores the Sport Type filter.

panels.title: When You Ride

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM date)::int
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Mon' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tue' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Thu' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fri' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sat' WHEN 7 THEN 'Sun'
  END AS "Day",
  COUNT(*) AS "Rides"
FROM activities
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
GROUP BY 1, EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM date)::int
ORDER BY EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM date)::int;

panels.description: Ride count by day of week.

panels.title: Outdoor Records

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.* FROM (
SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Longest Ride' AS "Metric",
  CASE WHEN ROUND(MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 1) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN ROUND(MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 1) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND distance_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || ROUND(MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km' WHEN ROUND(MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 1) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND distance_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || ROUND(MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km' ELSE ROUND(MAX(distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km' END AS "Period Best",
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((MAX(distance_m)/1000.0)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND distance_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')) AS "Previous Period Best",
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((MAX(distance_m)/1000.0)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE distance_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')) AS "All Time Best"
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND distance_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Most Elevation',
  CASE WHEN ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(elevation_m)::numeric FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND elevation_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0)::text || ' m' WHEN ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(elevation_m)::numeric FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND elevation_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0)::text || ' m' ELSE ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0)::text || ' m' END,
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0)::text || ' m', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND elevation_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')),
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(elevation_m)::numeric, 0)::text || ' m', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE elevation_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}'))
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND elevation_m > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Longest Duration',
  CASE WHEN MAX(duration_s) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN MAX(duration_s) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(duration_s) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND duration_s > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || TO_CHAR(MAX(duration_s) * interval '1 second', 'HH24:MI:SS') WHEN MAX(duration_s) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(duration_s) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND duration_s > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || TO_CHAR(MAX(duration_s) * interval '1 second', 'HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_CHAR(MAX(duration_s) * interval '1 second', 'HH24:MI:SS') END,
  (SELECT COALESCE(TO_CHAR(MAX(duration_s) * interval '1 second', 'HH24:MI:SS'), 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND duration_s > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')),
  (SELECT COALESCE(TO_CHAR(MAX(duration_s) * interval '1 second', 'HH24:MI:SS'), 'No data') FROM activities WHERE duration_s > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}'))
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND duration_s > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Most Calories',
  CASE WHEN MAX(calories) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN MAX(calories) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(calories) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND calories > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || MAX(calories)::text || ' kcal' WHEN MAX(calories) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(calories) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND calories > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || MAX(calories)::text || ' kcal' ELSE MAX(calories)::text || ' kcal' END,
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(calories)::text || ' kcal', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND calories > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')),
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(calories)::text || ' kcal', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE calories > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}'))
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND calories > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Highest Avg Power',
  CASE WHEN MAX(avg_power) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN MAX(avg_power) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(avg_power) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_power > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || MAX(avg_power)::text || ' W' WHEN MAX(avg_power) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(avg_power) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_power > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || MAX(avg_power)::text || ' W' ELSE MAX(avg_power)::text || ' W' END,
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(avg_power)::text || ' W', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_power > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')),
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(avg_power)::text || ' W', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE avg_power > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}'))
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND avg_power > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Highest Avg Speed',
  CASE WHEN ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND distance_m > 5000 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km/h' WHEN ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND distance_m > 5000 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km/h' ELSE ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km/h' END,
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km/h', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND distance_m > 5000 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')),
  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(avg_speed_kmh)::numeric, 1)::text || ' km/h', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND distance_m > 5000 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}'))
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND avg_speed_kmh > 0 AND distance_m > 5000 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Highest Avg HR',
  CASE WHEN MAX(avg_hr) IS NULL THEN 'No data' WHEN MAX(avg_hr) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(avg_hr) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_hr > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▲ ' || MAX(avg_hr)::text || ' bpm' WHEN MAX(avg_hr) < COALESCE((SELECT MAX(avg_hr) FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_hr > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')), 0) THEN '▼ ' || MAX(avg_hr)::text || ' bpm' ELSE MAX(avg_hr)::text || ' bpm' END,
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(avg_hr)::text || ' bpm', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND avg_hr > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')),
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(avg_hr)::text || ' bpm', 'No data') FROM activities WHERE avg_hr > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}'))
  FROM activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND avg_hr > 0 AND is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR sport_type = '${sport_type}')
) m ORDER BY m.ord;

panels.description:
Best values for each metric.

Period Best — highest in the selected time range.

▲ = better than previous equivalent period.

▼ = worse than previous equivalent period.

Previous Period Best — same duration window before the current one.

All Time Best — lifetime best (outdoor only).

panels.title: Ride Map

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.lat AS "latitude", s.lng AS "longitude", a.date AS "time" FROM activity_streams s JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.date) AND s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lng IS NOT NULL AND a.is_indoor IS NOT TRUE AND (('${sport_type}' = 'all') OR a.sport_type = '${sport_type}') AND s.time_offset % 10 = 0 ORDER BY a.date, s.time_offset LIMIT 500000;
